procedures.description: A list of normalized procedures along with their associated textual evidences extracted from the source document.

norm_procedure_name.description: The normalized, standard name of the medical or operational procedure.

procedure_evidences.description: An array of specific evidence elements that back up the identified procedure.

text.description: The exact text snippet acting as evidence.

pg_no.description: The literal page number where this evidence snippet resides.

reftxtbefore.description: The bounding text immediately preceding the evidence snippet for context validation.

reftxtafter.description: The bounding text immediately following the evidence snippet for context validation.
